title: Page 86
transc:
7.40 P. M.
Sheldon Ft Monroe  Wash DC May 31. 1864
Nancy for paradise Begs ---- vessels at hastings
with stores Saxon Amen should go as far as
homer & ascend to White house if wicked
all clear & stores wanted there zebra I
presume that nankin has passed that Vernon &
that it is saddled & in plation with
opal of Attica Ere this time Walrus bender


Beckwith  Wash June 2 1864 .
Rebecca luke brooks magic tulip
Yours of Clotilda just recd
pause I have nearly exhausted
all my resources of wriggles
to utopia you but if
you can use them to
advantage I can send you
Clarke or Edwards good waylands
of Smith libel militia ----
many of them are anxious
to go Shall I send
them Stanhope Wiley lamb End
